info.name: SPARK-273 Reservation Flow
info.description: Send requests individually. Review the immutable quote before setting acceptedQuoteId. Check positive Payment readiness or immediate zero confirmation. Provider checkout is a separate manual step.

exec: // Send requests manually. Customer consent and asynchronous reads are separate checkpoints.
throw new Error('Run 00.2 Driver login first.');

request.description: If the account has several registered cars, enter the canonical plate of the car you intend to use and resend this request.

exec: pm.test('UserService returns the Driver vehicle list', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
if (pm.response.code !== 200) throw new Error('Unexpected HTTP ' + pm.response.code + '. See the response and manual guide.');

const eligible = selected ? cars.find(v => v.canonicalPlate === selected) : cars.length === 1 ? cars[0] : null;
pm.test('A canonical plate is selected from the registered CAR list', () => pm.expect(Boolean(eligible)).to.eql(true));
if (!eligible) throw new Error('Choose an eligible registered CAR and enter its canonical plate.');

const sameTime = (a, b) => Number.isFinite(Date.parse(a)) && Date.parse(a) === Date.parse(b);
sameTime(data.start, selection.start) && sameTime(data.end, selection.end) && data.paymentMethod === selection.paymentMethod;

Number.isSafeInteger(data.bookedAmount) && data.bookedAmount >= 0 && Number.isSafeInteger(data.depositAmount) && data.depositAmount >= 0 && Number.isSafeInteger(data.coveredAmount) && data.coveredAmount >= 0 && data.depositAmount + data.coveredAmount === data.bookedAmount &&
pm.test('Quote matches the reviewed selection', () => pm.expect(binds).to.eql(true));
if (!binds || !terms) throw new Error('The paid review does not match the expected commercial terms.');

exec: if (!(env.get('submittedIntent') && env.get('reservationIdempotencyKey') && env.get('requestId') && env.get('driverAccountId') === env.get('reviewedAccountId'))) { pm.execution.skipRequest(); throw new Error('Missing scenario prerequisite. Follow the manual guide.'); }

request.description: Manual diagnostic snapshot. Repeat only as needed after processing. Look for four successful checks and the accepted outcome HOLD_CREATED or CONFIRMED.

exec: if (!(env.get('requestId') && env.get('driverAccountId') === env.get('reviewedAccountId'))) { pm.execution.skipRequest(); throw new Error('Missing scenario prerequisite. Follow the manual guide.'); }
if (pm.response.code !== 200) throw new Error('Unexpected HTTP ' + pm.response.code + '. See the response and manual guide.');
if (response.success !== true || !response.data) throw new Error('Expected the successful data envelope.');
const valid = data.requestId === env.get('requestId') && Number.isSafeInteger(data.version) && data.version >= 0 &&
pm.test('Snapshot belongs to the request and has all checks', () => pm.expect(Boolean(valid)).to.eql(true));
if (!valid) throw new Error('Progress response mismatch.');
throw new Error('ADMISSION_IN_PROGRESS. Re-read this request manually after processing.');
pm.test('All four checks succeeded and admission committed', () => pm.expect(hold).to.eql(true));
if (!hold) throw new Error('Admission stopped. Inspect admissionState, outcomeCode and checks.');

request.description: A committed receipt must identify the same hold as progress. A pending receipt requires a later manual read.

exec: if (!(env.get('requestId') && env.get('driverAccountId') === env.get('reviewedAccountId'))) { pm.execution.skipRequest(); throw new Error('Missing scenario prerequisite. Follow the manual guide.'); }
pm.test('Operations returns the durable receipt', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
if (pm.response.code !== 200) throw new Error('Unexpected HTTP ' + pm.response.code + '. See the response and manual guide.');
if (response.success !== true || !response.data) throw new Error('Expected the successful data envelope.');
pm.test('Receipt is version 3 and preserves request identity', () => pm.expect(valid).to.eql(true));
if (!valid) throw new Error('Receipt binding mismatch.');
if (!['HOLD_CREATED','CONFIRMED'].includes(data.state)) throw new Error('Admission has not succeeded. Inspect receipt state and code.');
pm.test('Receipt and Saga progress identify the same reservation', () => pm.expect(hold).to.eql(true));
if (!hold) throw new Error('Run 04.1 and compare the reservation identity.');

request.description: Verify the admitted lifecycle and accepted deposit. A zero deposit confirms immediately. Financial identifiers may arrive later.

exec: if (!(env.get('requestId') && env.get('driverAccountId') === env.get('reviewedAccountId') && env.get('reservationId') && env.get('submittedIntent'))) { pm.execution.skipRequest(); throw new Error('Missing scenario prerequisite. Follow the manual guide.'); }
pm.test('Operations returns the own reservation', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
if (pm.response.code !== 200) throw new Error('Unexpected HTTP ' + pm.response.code + '. See the response and manual guide.');
if (response.success !== true || !response.data) throw new Error('Expected the successful data envelope.');
const sameTime = (a, b) => Number.isFinite(Date.parse(a)) && Date.parse(a) === Date.parse(b);
const binds = data.requestId === env.get('requestId') && data.reservationId === env.get('reservationId') &&
data.siteId === env.get('resolvedSiteId') && sameTime(data.start, selection.start) && sameTime(data.end, selection.end) &&
pm.test('Own reservation matches the accepted quote and receipt', () => pm.expect(binds).to.eql(true));
if (!binds) throw new Error('Own reservation binding mismatch.');

pm.test('Admission matches the accepted deposit', () => pm.expect(data.depositAmount === 0 ? data.state === 'CONFIRMED' && data.holdExpiresAt === null && !!data.confirmedAt : data.state === 'PENDING_PAYMENT' && data.orderId === null && Date.parse(data.holdExpiresAt) > Date.now()).to.eql(true));

request.description: Payment owns checkout state. Continue to checkout only while the Operations hold is live and Payment reports PAYABLE.

exec: if (!(env.get('requestId') && env.get('driverAccountId') === env.get('reviewedAccountId') && env.get('reservationId') && env.get('submittedIntent'))) { pm.execution.skipRequest(); throw new Error('Missing scenario prerequisite. Follow the manual guide.'); }
if (pm.response.code !== 200) throw new Error('Payment read failed.');

request.description: Final no-payment assertion. Payment resolves the authenticated order before Operations binds settlement.

exec: if (!(env.get('requestId') && env.get('driverAccountId') === env.get('reviewedAccountId') && env.get('paymentOrderId') && env.get('checkoutState') === 'PAYABLE' && env.get('reservationState') === 'PENDING_PAYMENT' && Date.parse(env.get('holdExpiresAt')) > Date.now())) { pm.execution.skipRequest(); throw new Error('Missing scenario prerequisite. Follow the manual guide.'); }
pm.test('Payment resolves the genuine order to its original reservation', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
if (pm.response.code !== 200) throw new Error('Unexpected HTTP ' + pm.response.code + '. See the response and manual guide.');
if (response.success !== true || !response.data) throw new Error('Expected the successful data envelope.');

pm.test('Order points to the original active unpaid request', () => pm.expect(data.state === 'PAYABLE' && data.reservationId === env.get('reservationId') && data.orderId === env.get('paymentOrderId') && Date.parse(env.get('holdExpiresAt')) > Date.now()).to.eql(true));

exec: if (!(env.get('paymentOrderId') && env.get('reservationId') && Number(env.get('reviewedDepositAmount')) > 0 && env.get('driverAccountId') === env.get('reviewedAccountId'))) { pm.execution.skipRequest(); throw new Error('Capture the positive scenario in 04.4 first.'); }
pm.test("Operations confirmed the original reservation against the captured Payment order", () => {

item.name: 06 – Confirmed zero deposit
item.description: Use an authoritative zero-deposit quote in steps 02–04. A zero tariff is sufficient. A covered positive tariff requires genuine coverage from its owner.

item.name: 06.1 Verify immediate confirmation and optional receipt linkage

request.description: Run after zero admission and repeat after financial record creation to see linkage.

exec: if (!(env.get('requestId') && env.get('driverAccountId') === env.get('reviewedAccountId') && env.get('reservationId') && env.get('submittedIntent'))) { pm.execution.skipRequest(); throw new Error('Missing scenario prerequisite. Follow the manual guide.'); }

item.name: 07.1 Reject changed intent under the same key

request.description: Run explicitly after the positive path. Retains the original scenario and sends a different valid end with the same idempotency key.

exec: if (!(env.get('requestId') && env.get('driverAccountId') === env.get('reviewedAccountId') && env.get('submittedIntent') && env.get('reservationIdempotencyKey'))) { pm.execution.skipRequest(); throw new Error('Missing scenario prerequisite. Follow the manual guide.'); }
pm.test('Stable idempotency conflict error', () => pm.expect(body.success === false && body.code === 'IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED').to.eql(true));

request.description: Run after completing the authenticated scenario. This request deliberately omits the Driver token.

exec: if (!(env.get('reservationId'))) { pm.execution.skipRequest(); throw new Error('Missing scenario prerequisite. Follow the manual guide.'); }
pm.test('Own reservation requires a Driver session', () => pm.response.to.have.status(401));
pm.test('Stable unauthenticated error', () => pm.expect(body.success === false && body.code === 'UNAUTHENTICATED').to.eql(true));
